content_sections.text: Academic certificates such as marks list, pass certificate, provisional certificate, testimonials and certificates of professional skills if any Certificate evidencing date of birth Latest Community certificate A duly stamped self addressed postal cover Local candidate certificate as per G.O.Ms.No.124 dated 30-08-2018 One passport size recent photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer, affixed on the application

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the format enclosed with the notification. Affix a recent passport size photograph attested by a Gazetted Officer at the top of the application. Enclose attested copies of the listed documents and a duly stamped self addressed postal cover. Address the application to the Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Mahabubnagar. Send by registered post or courier service only; applications by hand are not received. Application must be received before 5:00 p.m. on 30-11-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Court Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Mahabubnagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form enclosed with the notification (page 4)) and send it to The Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Mahabubnagar, by registered post or courier service only; no applications by hand, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 46 years (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years, Physically handicapped persons 10 years, Ex-Servicemen As per Rule 12(1)(c)(i) of Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration of Rs.3000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Must have passed any exam between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent examination; candidates with qualification higher than 10th class are not eligible.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Special Judicial Magistrate of Second Class Courts function Monday to Friday between 7.30 a.m. and 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates having higher qualification than 10th class. Candidates resorting to bring any influence of any kind will be disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of marks obtained in the qualifying examination if more than 20 candidates apply for each vacancy. Candidates considered most suitable for appointment will be called. If more than 20 candidates apply for each vacancy, applications will be shortlisted on marks obtained in the qualifying examination.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Term of the post as per instructions issued by the Hon'ble High Court from time to time or until the need for the post ceases.
